title.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭去 Nvidia 執行長，財務長 Colette Kress 接任臨時執行長
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO

summary.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務並即刻生效；Nvidia 同時任命 Harvey C. Jones 為首任董事會主席，董事會將尋找正式繼任人選。
summary.en: Huang stepped down as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately. Nvidia also appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first board chair while it searches for a permanent successor.

title.zh-TW: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 投資人說明會
title.en: Anthropic begins its IPO roadshow

summary.zh-TW: 預計每股 70 至 78 美元，基本發行最多募資約 625 億美元；另有 7 家投資方計畫投入 260 億美元。
summary.en: Shares are expected at $70–78, raising up to about $62.5B in the base offering; seven investors plan to put in a further $26B.

title.zh-TW: Google 攜三星推出搭載 Gemini 的 AI 智慧眼鏡
title.en: Google and Samsung launch Gemini-powered AI smart glasses

summary.zh-TW: 整合語音 AI、即時翻譯、導航與拍照，並加入拍攝指示燈與旁觀者臉部遮蔽等隱私措施。
summary.en: Features include voice AI, live translation, navigation and photos, plus privacy measures such as a recording indicator light and bystander face blurring.

title.zh-TW: Linux 基金會調查：近 6 成團隊交付速度超過資安審查
title.en: Linux Foundation survey: nearly 6 in 10 teams ship faster than security can review

summary.zh-TW: 58% 受訪者表示交付速度已快到安全審查跟不上，60% 表示 AI 程式開發工具增加了外部相依套件。
summary.en: 58% said delivery now outpaces security review, and 60% said AI coding tools have added more external dependencies.

title.zh-TW: Anthropic 發表 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2

summary.zh-TW: 輸出速度最高提升 30%、價格降 20%；兩者底層相同，Mythos 僅開放符合資格的資安與生命科學組織申請。
summary.en: Output is up to 30% faster and prices are 20% lower. Both share the same underlying model; Mythos is available only to qualifying security and life-science organizations.

title.zh-TW: Meta 推出 Muse Ember 模型
title.en: Meta launches the Muse Ember model

summary.zh-TW: 定價每百萬 token 輸入 0.10、輸出 0.50 美元，支援 1M context。
summary.en: Priced at $0.10 input and $0.50 output per million tokens, with a 1M-token context window.

title.zh-TW: DeepMind AlphaProof Code 形式化驗證 Signal 核心實作
title.en: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal's core implementation

summary.zh-TW: 多 LLM 代理框架產出逾 600 萬行經機器檢查的 Lean 證明，約四週內驗證 libsignal 的關鍵安全性質。（週報彙整）
summary.en: A multi-LLM agentic framework produced over six million lines of machine-checked Lean proofs, verifying key security properties of libsignal in about four weeks. (Weekly roundup)

title.zh-TW: OpenAI 發表資安專用模型 GPT-6 Cyber
title.en: OpenAI unveils security model GPT-6 Cyber

summary.zh-TW: 在 Firefox 找出 81 個先前未知的高風險漏洞，並針對 Linux 核心漏洞開發出可運作的提權攻擊程式。
summary.en: It found 81 previously unknown high-severity bugs in Firefox and built working privilege-escalation exploits for Linux kernel vulnerabilities.

title.zh-TW: OpenAI 推出 Businesses in ChatGPT
title.en: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT

summary.zh-TW: 企業可在 ChatGPT 建立商家檔案、更新商品與價格，並由 Business Agent 回答消費者問題。
summary.en: Businesses can create profiles, update products and prices, and let a Business Agent answer customer questions.

title.zh-TW: Meta 收購 AI 程式開發協作平臺 Conductor
title.en: Meta acquires AI coding collaboration startup Conductor

summary.zh-TW: Conductor 讓開發人員同時指派多個 AI 代理在背景撰寫程式、測試與除錯。
summary.en: Conductor lets developers assign multiple AI agents to write, test and debug code in the background.

title.zh-TW: Node.js 22／24／26 安全更新
title.en: Node.js 22, 24 and 26 security releases

summary.zh-TW: 修正 HTTP/2 等高風險漏洞，請升級至 v22.23.5、v24.22.3 或 v26.13.1；已停止支援的版本不會修補。
summary.en: Fixes high-severity issues including HTTP/2. Upgrade to v22.23.5, v24.22.3 or v26.13.1; end-of-life lines receive no fix.

title.zh-TW: TypeScript 7.1 Beta 恢復編譯器 API
title.en: TypeScript 7.1 Beta restores the compiler API

summary.zh-TW: Go 原生編譯器的首次更新，恢復 7.0 移除的程式化 API；RC 與正式版暫定 11 月下旬。
summary.en: The first update to the Go-based native compiler brings back the programmatic API removed in 7.0. RC and stable releases are tentatively planned for late November.

title.zh-TW: Next.js 11 月安全更新
title.en: Next.js November security release

summary.en: Security fixes shipped in v16.4.5 and v15.5.29, followed by v16.4.6 on Nov 10.

title.zh-TW: Postman 桌面版未經同意安裝 AI 外掛引發爭議
title.en: Postman desktop installed AI plugins without consent

summary.zh-TW: 使用者發現 Postman 自動安裝 Codex 與 Claude Code 外掛並嘗試代為核准 Hook，官方承諾改善同意流程。
summary.en: Users found Postman auto-installing Codex and Claude Code plugins and trying to pre-approve a hook; the company pledged to fix its consent flow.

title.zh-TW: CNCF 宣布 KubeVirt 畢業
title.en: CNCF graduates KubeVirt

summary.zh-TW: KubeVirt 讓 VM、容器與 AI 工作負載共用同一個 Kubernetes 控制平面，於 KubeCon NA 宣布。
summary.en: KubeVirt runs VMs, containers and AI workloads under one Kubernetes control plane. Announced at KubeCon NA.

title.zh-TW: AWS 推出由 AI 代理開發的本機模擬器 AWS Emulator
title.en: AWS launches AWS Emulator, built by AI agents

summary.zh-TW: 可在本機模擬 AWS API 測試應用程式，不必連線雲端服務。
summary.en: It emulates AWS APIs locally, so developers can test apps without connecting to the cloud.

title.zh-TW: AKS LTS 支援 Kubernetes 1.37，未支援版本將被強制升級
title.en: AKS LTS adds Kubernetes 1.37; unsupported clusters face forced upgrades

summary.zh-TW: 2027 年 6 月 1 日起，停留在未支援版本的叢集將由平台依其時程升級。
summary.en: From June 1, 2027, clusters left on unsupported versions will be upgraded by the platform on its own schedule.

title.zh-TW: Google Cloud 公布 AI-native Kubernetes 堆疊
title.en: Google Cloud outlines an AI-native Kubernetes stack

summary.zh-TW: 包含 llm-d 1.0、KubeRay 等元件，鎖定強化學習後訓練、推論與多輪代理執行。（週報彙整）
summary.en: Components include llm-d 1.0 and KubeRay, targeting RL post-training, inference and multi-turn agent execution. (Weekly roundup)

title.zh-TW: Amazon ECS Gateway 上線
title.en: Amazon ECS Gateway launches

summary.zh-TW: 帳號層級的入口資源，服務取得自動產生的主機名稱；目前文件未提到自訂網域。
summary.en: An account-level ingress resource. Services get generated hostnames; current docs don't cover custom domains.

title.zh-TW: ElastiCache Serverless 新增向量與全文搜尋
title.en: ElastiCache Serverless adds vector and full-text search

summary.zh-TW: 支援向量、全文與混合查詢，可用於 AI 代理記憶、推薦與 RAG。
summary.en: Supports vector, full-text and hybrid queries for AI agent memory, recommendations and RAG.

title.zh-TW: AMD 推出第 6 代 EPYC（Venice）
title.en: AMD launches 6th Gen EPYC (Venice)

summary.zh-TW: 採 Zen 6 架構，最高 256 核心，支援 PCIe Gen 6 與 CXL 3.1。
summary.en: Built on Zen 6 with up to 256 cores, supporting PCIe Gen 6 and CXL 3.1.

title.zh-TW: 微軟 11 月 Patch Tuesday 修補逾千個漏洞
title.en: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixes over 1,000 flaws

summary.zh-TW: 共 63 個重大等級，含已遭利用的 Outlook 零時差漏洞 CVE-2026-124194（各家統計總數為 1,093～1,095）。
summary.en: 63 are rated Critical, including an exploited Outlook zero-day, CVE-2026-124194. Reported totals range from 1,093 to 1,095.

verdict.zh-TW: 各家統計結果不同，來源未說明原因。本站以區間（1,093～1,095）呈現，不採用單一數字。
verdict.en: Counts differ across sources, which don't explain why. We show a range (1,093–1,095) rather than pick one.

title.zh-TW: Apache HTTP Server 修補重大 HTTP/2 RCE
title.en: Apache HTTP Server patches a critical HTTP/2 RCE

summary.zh-TW: CVE-2026-119618 影響 2.4.55～2.4.70，請升級至 2.4.71；由 Anthropic 與 Google 回報。
summary.en: CVE-2026-119618 affects 2.4.55–2.4.70; upgrade to 2.4.71. Reported by Anthropic and Google.

title.zh-TW: Chrome 修補已遭利用的零時差漏洞
title.en: Chrome fixes an exploited zero-day

summary.zh-TW: Chrome 157.0.8103.50 修正 9 個 CVE，其中 CVE-2026-125350 已遭實際利用。
summary.en: Chrome 157.0.8103.50 resolves nine CVEs, including CVE-2026-125350, which is exploited in the wild.

title.zh-TW: Android 11 月公告：免互動遠端執行漏洞
title.en: Android November bulletin: zero-click remote code execution

summary.zh-TW: CVE-2026-58868 影響 Android 14～17，需安全性修補程式等級 2026-11-01 以上。
summary.en: CVE-2026-58868 affects Android 14–17. Security patch level 2026-11-01 or later is required.

title.zh-TW: Fireworks AI 遭駭波及 Notion
title.en: Fireworks AI breach affects Notion

summary.zh-TW: Notion 停用 Insights 功能；Fireworks 確認部分客戶帳務資料、資料集與不完整模型權重遭存取。
summary.en: Notion disabled its Insights feature; Fireworks confirmed some customer billing data, datasets and partial model weights were accessed.

title.zh-TW: SonicWall GMS 免登入檔案讀取漏洞，產品已無修補
title.en: SonicWall GMS flaw allows unauthenticated file reads; no patch coming

summary.zh-TW: 最高 9.1 分；產品已終止支援，官方建議遷移至 NSM。
summary.en: Scored up to 9.1. The product is end-of-life, and the vendor recommends migrating to NSM.
